sources.entry: PushBits - Notification server for relaying push notifications via Matrix, similar to PushBullet and Gotify. ISC Go

summary.one_liner: PushBits is an alpha-stage relay server that accepts push notifications through a web API and delivers them to users over Matrix.
summary.what_it_does: PushBits exposes a simple web API for sending notifications and forwards them to users through Matrix, so recipients need no dedicated app. It supports multiple users, each with multiple channels (applications). It is designed to be compatible with Gotify's message-sending API, so existing Gotify senders may work. Management is done through an API and a CLI for users and applications. Optional checks against HIBP flag weak passwords, and Argon2 is used for password storage. Two-factor authentication and bi-directional key verification are listed as unchecked, not yet implemented.
use_cases: relay push notifications to phone via Matrix
replace Pushover or Gotify-style alerts without a new app
send alerts from scripts or servers through a web API
receive monitoring or homelab notifications over Matrix
notable: Delivers notifications through Matrix, so no custom client app is needed
Argon2 password hashing with optional HIBP weak-password check
Multiple users with multiple applications (channels) each
Managed via both API and CLI
caveats: Maintainers wanted; the author can no longer actively work on the project
Two-factor authentication and bi-directional key verification are not yet implemented
